title: Decode String
description: Decode a string where k[encoded_string] means encoded_string is repeated k times.
pseudocode:
1. stack = []; curStr = ''; curNum = 0
2. for char in s:
3.   if char == '[': stack.push([curStr, curNum]); curStr = ''; curNum = 0
4.   else if char == ']': prevStr, num = stack.pop(); curStr = prevStr + curStr * num
5.   else if isDigit(char): curNum = curNum * 10 + int(char)
6.   else: curStr += char

steps.note: char '[' detected, push curStr('') and curNum(2) to stack
